# Channel patterns

## Landing page

Use a clear value proposition, evidence and CTA hierarchy.

## Email

One message/decision per email when possible; subject/preheader/body/CTA should reinforce the same intent.

## Short social/ad copy

Front-load the hook/value but avoid clickbait disconnected from the destination.

## Product/UI copy

Prioritize clarity and state/action feedback over persuasion.

Do not reuse the same copy density across all channels.
